# Eskimo Travel

> > Eskimo Travel provides international eSIM data plans for travelers with 4G/5G connectivity, free trials, and coverage across 150+ countries including regional and global options.

Eskimo Travel offers prepaid eSIM plans with data rollover, eliminating the need for physical SIM cards or Pocket WiFi devices. Plans start from $4-$7 with instant activation via QR code, available through their mobile apps on Google Play and App Store.

## Key Topics

- eSIM technology
- International roaming
- Travel data plans
- 4G/5G connectivity
- Prepaid data
- Free trial offers
- Data rollover
- Global coverage
- Mobile internet
- Pocket WiFi alternative
- Regional eSIM plans
- Instant activation
- QR code provisioning
- Multi-country coverage
- Travel connectivity
